parameters.name: CategoryDescription
parameters.description: Person library description. Supports up to 512 characters, including both Chinese and English characters.

parameters.name: CategoryId
parameters.description:
Person library ID. This ID uniquely identifies a custom person library. It is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness.

Note: This ID must not be the same as any system person library ID. If it matches a system ID, the system person library will be used by default. The ID can contain up to 120 characters, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is case-insensitive. You can query this using the [List all persons and face information in a person library](~~187787~~) API.

parameters.name: CategoryName
parameters.description: Person library name. Supports up to 512 characters, including both Chinese and English characters.

parameters.name: PersonDescription

parameters.name: PersonId
parameters.description:
Person ID. This ID uniquely identifies a custom person. It is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness.

The ID can contain up to 120 characters, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is case-insensitive. You can query this using the [List all persons and face information in a person library](~~187787~~) API. The returned FaceId is of type String.
